agent.summary:
All three alerts have cleared. The services were healthy; the alert rules misinterpreted normal behavior:

- Accounting latency included idle time waiting for Kafka orders. I excluded that span from the latency rule.
- Chatbot receives no generated traffic, and MCP is disabled in the agent configuration. I excluded both from the no-requests rule.

Verified HTTP 200 responses from the storefront, product API, chatbot, and MCP initialization.
